ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, legal representatives and senior management against the UIAF lists, UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated sanctions list, and Colombian national sanctions and PEP registries prior to incorporation, consistent with Law 1121 of 2006 and Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia Circular Externa 007 of 2020.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) and the local Cámara de Comercio portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish or contain recognized Spanish transliteration of foreign words; the suffix 'S.A.S.' is mandatory for simplified stock companies; identical or confusingly similar names are prohibited.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the incorporator may file a written reconsideration request before the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days; if denied, an administrative appeal may be filed with the Superintendencia de Sociedades. A fresh name reservation application with alternative proposed names may be submitted concurrently to avoid delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office for a thermoforming medical device manufacturing enterprise; a physical production facility and administrative office in Colombia are required, though a virtual office may serve only supplementary administrative correspondence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High estimated likelihood of approximately 70% within the first 18 months, driven by mandatory INVIMA sanitary inspections for medical device manufacturing sites and periodic commercial registry verification.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Código de Comercio de Colombia (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 98-120, 353-373; Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1-5, 10-14, 17-27; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social acting through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); Superintendencia de Sociedades for legal supervision
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos (private deed of incorporation and bylaws) recorded in the Registro Mercantil; evidenced by the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-up capital is required for a SAS; incorporation may proceed with zero paid capital. Capital subscriptions may be paid in cash or in kind, the shareholders determine payment terms in the bylaws, and unpaid subscriptions remain obligations of the shareholders. No escrow account is required under Colombian law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF SOCIEDAD POR ACCIONES SIMPLIFICADA. The shareholders and directors, present on this day of ________, have RESOLVED unanimously: 1. SUBSCRIPTION. The share capital described in Article __ of the bylaws is subscribed and allocated to the shareholders proportionally, to be paid within the terms permitted by Law 1258 of 2008. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered office is fixed at ______________, Colombia; all notices may be served there. 3. APPOINTMENTS. The Legal Representative and the Secretary are appointed with the powers and duties granted by law and by the bylaws. 4. FILING. The Legal Representative is authorized to register this resolution and the company before the Cámara de Comercio and DIAN and to obtain the tax identification number. Approved in accordance with the bylaws.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social / RUES portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the Chamber of Commerce online platform, run an exact-name and homonym search for the proposed SAS denomination, confirm that no conflicting or restricted trade name is registered, and obtain a provisional reservation of the statutory name.
required_dossiers: Completed RUES name-search form
Identification document of each incorporator (cédula, NIT, or valid passport)
Power of attorney, if acted by a third party
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is denied on grounds of homonymy or confusion, submit three alternative names in a single new filing; the reservation may be renewed with the Chamber’s fee and does not confer exclusive registration right.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the SAS charter and bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish, setting out the corporate purpose for thermoforming and automated trimming of multilayer dental clear-aligner sheets, capital, shares, board decision rules, legal representation, corporate domicile, and quorum provisions. Complete and sign the commercial registry forms and arrange prior recognition of signatures before a notary if requested by the Chamber.
required_dossiers: Draft private charter and bylaws
Name reservation certificate obtained from RUES
Capital subscription list and intended payment schedule
Certification of in-kind contributions, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber requires a public deed because real property or regulated in-kind assets are contributed, convert the instrument into a public deed before a notary and re-file the registration forms without additional corporate penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the company in the Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social / RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation file online or in person, pay the variable mercantile registration tariff, and obtain the initial matrícula mercantil. The registrar will verify legal capacity, corporate purpose, representation clauses, and consistency with the RUES database before registering the company and issuing the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución and bylaws
Formulario de Matrícula Mercantil
RUES registration request
Proof of registered office (lease or ownership deed)
Identification document of shareholders and legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, correct the noted defects within ten business days and resubmit without paying a second registration duty for the same act; if the Chamber misclassifies the economic activity, address the technical correction to the registration official and amend the ISIC code.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) via MUISCA portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the commercial registration certificate, use the DIAN MUISCA platform to update the RUT, recognize the assigned NIT, elect the tax address, declare the applicable tax responsibilities, enable electronic invoicing, and confirm the activity code for manufacture of dental aligner materials.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Pre-filled RUT form
Bylaws and legal representation certificate
Identification documents of shareholders and legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT is rejected due to inconsistent data, correct the information in MUISCA and, if necessary, request the Chamber of Commerce to issue an amended annotation before resubmitting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain certified certificate of existence and legal representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request the certified Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal from the Chamber to evidence the company’s current legal representative, authorized activity, and registered address. Verify that the registered purpose expressly covers thermoforming and trimming of dental clear-aligner sheets for the medical devices sector.
required_dossiers: Copy of the initial commercial registry sheet
Identification document of the requesting legal representative
Proof of payment of Chamber certificate fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate shows outdated officer or activity information, request an annotation of the first board resolution before the Chamber and obtain an amended certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the certificate is issued, present the hard-bound commercial books (inventory and balances book, daily journal, shareholders book, and board book where applicable) to the Chamber for stamping before such books are used. The company may alternatively maintain electronically generated books that meet the legal software and preservation requirements.
required_dossiers: Application for commercial books registration
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Identification document of legal representative
Commercial books to be stamped
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a book is rejected for lack of formal binding or page requirements, replace it with a compliant book, pay the difference of fee where applicable, and request stamping before entering any transactions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register as employer and set up occupational risk coverage
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: ARL, EPS and pension administrator, payroll declaration via PILA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer with the social security system, choose an Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), classify the workplace risk for a thermoforming industrial plant, implement the minimum SG-SST standards, and prepare the payroll plan before hiring any worker.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT and NIT
Bylaws and legal representative identification
ISO/ISIC 3250 activity description
Workplace layout and employee list, if hiring
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ARL misclassifies the industrial risk, submit the ISIC 3250 description and INVIMA medical-device manufacturing permits to the ARL for a corrected risk class; payroll should be declared on the target date to avoid late-payment fines.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First governance filing and pre-operational industrial licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio, INVIMA, and municipal fire/environmental offices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold and minute the first board meeting approving the start of operations; record officer acceptance statements before the Chamber; then submit the INVIMA medical-device sanitary registration or BPM application and the industrial fire-safety and environmental registration forms described in the licensing section. Begin production only after all relevant pre-operational permits are physically ready.
required_dossiers: First board resolution and officer acceptance statements
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Plant address, layout plan and structural load description
Fire-safety inspection form
Environmental registration and waste-management plan
INVIMA medical-device registration/BPM application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an industrial or INVIMA permit is queried, submit the technical corrective plan within the official response term; INVIMA BPM inspections may require three to six months of additional review but do not automatically constitute a denial.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA - Dirección de Dispositivos Médicos y Otros Productos; territorial Secretaría de Salud; Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Dispositivos Médicos and Certificado de Cumplimiento de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM) for Medical Devices; custom dental aligners may be subject to notificación sanitaria for custom devices where applicable

environmental_impact_assessment.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA), Corporación Autónoma Regional, or Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente as the local environmental authority
environmental_impact_assessment.classification_tier: Category III - Low-impact manufacturing: a full Environmental Impact Study is not mandatory for a thermoforming line under Article 9 of Decreto 1076 de 2015; a simplified environmental diagnosis, preoperational environmental registration, and waste-management plan are required
environmental_impact_assessment.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No significant process wastewater is expected from dry thermoforming; any cooling or scrubber discharge to sewer must meet Resolución 0631 de 2015 limits (pH 6.0-9.0, TSS <= 100 mg/L, BOD5 <= 100 mg/L, COD <= 300 mg/L). VOC and thermal emissions from sheet heating and trimming must be captured and filtered with activated carbon or equivalent technology, with hazardous waste manifests kept under Resolución 1407 de 2018.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos technical inspection and fire-safety certificate covering exits, extinguishers, separation of stored PETG/PU sheets, and hot-work control; Curaduría Urbana/Alcaldía structural-load compatibility inspection for the production equipment; and occupational safety and health clearance under SG-SST with ARL risk classification and Ministry of Labor workplace-condition compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - Colombian Tax and Customs Authority; official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional portal: muisca.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian S.A.S., incorporate by private instrument filed with the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio); obtain the certificate of existence and legal representation; complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) as a resident corporation with IVA-responsible and exporter status; DIAN assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Foreign non-resident entities without local incorporation obtain a NIT/RUT through DIAN by appointing a Colombian legal representative; digital services providers must complete the simplified e-service registration before charging Colombian VAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. An S.A.S. formed in Colombia is a resident legal entity taxed separately on worldwide income; no pass-through treatment is available. Non-resident branch/permanent establishment is taxed only on Colombian-source income unless a tax treaty applies. Zona Franca incentives require separate qualification and are not the default classification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election exists; Colombian entity classification is statutory and not elective. The S.A.S. may elect the SIMPLE tax regime if it meets legal turnover and staff thresholds; may elect accelerated deduction for qualifying fixed-asset investments; may apply exporters' customs programmes (e.g., Plan Vallejo) when qualified; and may adopt IFRS for tax accounting. Hybrid mismatch rules under Law 2010 of 2019 apply mandatorily and do not provide an elective opt-out; treaty benefits require economic substance and the corresponding DIAN reporting.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Value Added Tax), a destination-based credit-invoice VAT with complementary national consumption taxes; municipal ICA is a separate local tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Corporations have no de minimis VAT exemption: an S.A.S. is required to register as an IVA-responsible taxpayer from the first taxable operation. The natural-person exemption threshold under Article 499 E.T. is gross income not exceeding 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 174,296,500 for tax year 2025), but this threshold is not available to legal entities. Export transactions additionally require customs and RUT reporter status as exporter.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT-responsible taxpayers must issue electronic sales invoices (Factura Electrónica de Venta - FEV) using DIAN-authorized software or DIAN's free platform. The invoice is transmitted to DIAN for validation before or at issuance through interoperable APIs; each validated invoice carries a CUFE/CUNE digital stamp and QR code. Physical wet stamps are not accepted. Export sales must be linked to the electronic export declaration and customs acceptance records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods such as dental clear-aligner sheets qualify for the 0% IVA rate if the goods are sold for value to a foreign-domiciled buyer, exported through Colombian customs territory under an accepted export declaration, and physically removed from Colombia. Zero-rating of related services is allowed only where the service is performed entirely abroad or directly supports the exported goods. The exporter must be registered in the RUT as exporter and must hold the full documentary chain proving departure and receipt by the foreign buyer.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Accepted Declaración de Exportación (DEX/DAE) transmitted through VUCE/DIAN
Bill of Lading (BL), air waybill, or equivalent transport document evidencing physical departure
Commercial invoice with electronic CUFE validation
Certificate of origin where applicable or requested by the buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Canalización de Divisas) or foreign-currency settlement declaration from a Colombian financial intermediary
Proof of foreign-currency payment matching the export invoice
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN applies pre-audit validation, random inspections, and red-channel customs checks to export VAT refunds. Claiming 0% without the required export declaration, shipment evidence, or FX settlement causes reversal of the VAT credit, reclassification of the supply at 19%, assessment of unpaid VAT plus default interest, and the inaccuracy penalty under Article 648 E.T. Fraudulent export zero-rating or forged FX certificates can lead to exporter status cancellation, goods seizure, and criminal liability under Colombian customs and anti-smuggling legislation (Law 1762).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), acting through the foreign exchange regime (Régimen Cambiario), with DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) responsible for exchange-control declaration filings and customs validation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible for current-account transactions. Capital-account inflows, including foreign direct investment (FDI) into a SAS, require registration with Banco de la República in the International Investment Register (Registro Internacional de Inversiones) to secure future dividend remittance and capital repatriation rights. Profit remittances must be routed through the official foreign exchange market (Mercado Cambiario) via authorized intermediaries and are subject to the submission of Foreign Exchange Declarations (Declaración de Cambio). Delays or omissions in registration, in form or in substance, may render the remittance non-channeled and subject to fines, loss of tax benefits, and restrictions on upstreaming funds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds derived from goods or services (including production and sale of clear aligner sheets) must be collected and channeled into Colombia within six (6) months from the date of shipment or service completion. Channeling must be made through an authorized intermediary (a commercial bank) in the foreign exchange market. The mandatory surrender/conversion obligation applies to 100% of the export invoice value, except for de minimis transactions or specific exemptions granted under the FX regime; non-channeled amounts trigger penalties and are admitted only under the mechanisms set forth in the Colombian exchange-control rules.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Digital-only offshore EMI accounts cannot replace the mandatory local bank channeling obligation imposed by the Colombian FX regime. While Stripe and comparable payment gateways can collect consumer card payments on behalf of the Colombian SAS, settlement funds must ultimately be received through a licensed Colombian financial entity or an authorized FX intermediary, and the underlying cross-border payments must be recorded as export proceeds. Offshore EMIs that lack a Colombian license cannot legally act as the primary repository for operational funds, and funds held overseas without Banco de la República authorization may violate foreign-exchange disclosure duties.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person onboarding is generally required. Tier-1 banks in Colombia normally mandate a physical KYC interview with the legal representative of the SAS (or the duly appointed attorney-in-fact) at a local branch before opening an account. Remote onboarding is not a statutory right and, when offered, is restricted to local residents with prior banking relationships. For non-resident UBOS and shareholders, certified/apostilled corporate documents and a clearly evidenced registered office in Colombia are essential; some banks will require the ultimate beneficial owner to attend in person if the local representative cannot present valid notarial powers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign UBO with no Colombian ID or telephone record; name appears in watchlists or PEP databases.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled/certified passport copy, official CV, valid visa/residency certificate if present in Colombia, corporate chart attestation, notarized registers of shareholders, board resolution designating the UBO, and a detailed written explanation of the UBO's source of wealth and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered office and production facility appear as virtual or mismatched with stated manufacturing activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Rental contract or title deed, recent utility bills in the entity's name, photographs of plant/equipment and aligner sheet production lines, ISO certificates or sanitary/INVIMA-related documentation, and a local operations visit authorization letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Projected cross-border inflows from Stripe/credit card platforms inconsistent with low-risk manufacturing profile or treated as high-velocity digital money movement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial agreements with payment processors, samples of marketplace sales contracts, invoicing policies, logistics contracts for clear aligner distribution, sales forecasts, KYC files of distributors, and a compliance memorandum classifying the proceeds as export of goods under ISIC 3250.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dividends or capital repatriation patterns trigger scrutiny on equity origin and ability to remit abroad.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements evidencing capital injection through the formal FX market, the Banco de la República International Investment Registration certificate, prior tax returns, audited financial statements, transfer pricing documents, and a treasurer's/netting statement demonstrating compliance with FX regime.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of Colombian local substance (no independent legal/tax/accounting advisors) triggers shell company flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Engagement letters with Colombian law firm, tax advisors and external accountant registered with DIAN, payroll records for Colombian staff, and proof of a physical administrative office separate from the plant.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholders must wire capital contribution through an authorized Colombian commercial bank using the SWIFT MT103 network. The local bank records the inflow in the Declaración de Cambio under the concept code for 'Direct Investment – Capital in Companies' (or the equivalent code in force). Prior or simultaneous registration in Banco de la República's International Investment Register is required. Supporting documentation includes: apostilled incorporation documents of the investing entity or individual, the SAS bylaws, shareholder resolutions, identity and suitability documents, source-of-funds statements, and the bank's own KYC forms. The bank will verify the transaction against FDI regulations, sanctions lists, and tax forms; no funds may be released from a temporary account without deliverable confirmation of the registered investment.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Permitted clearing rails include: (i) SWIFT MT103 wires for supplier payments, licensing fees, intercompany purchases, and dividend distributions; (ii) documentary commercial letters of credit for high-value equipment imports or plastic/resin raw material consignments; (iii) local-currency (COP) wire through CUD/CENIT systems for domestic settlements; and (iv) centralized treasury batches via SWIFT/SCORE or API-connected platforms at the local bank. All outbound disbursements tied to foreign trade require the presentation of invoices, transport documents (e.g., B/L, AWB), customs declarations, contracts, and the corresponding tax withholding certificates; cross-border disbursements must be marked with the relevant concept code in the Foreign Exchange Declaration and may be subject to prior registration of the underlying debt or investment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Executable FX forwards (COP/USD and COP/other permissible crosses) with authorized local banks for trade-flow hedging
European-style FX options (call/put structures) contracted through authorized Colombian intermediaries
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for debt-related exposures

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs), provided the hedge documentary trail evidences a real commercial/financial exposure and execution is done through a Banco de la República-authorized intermediary in accordance with external regulation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Commercial Registration (Renovación de Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 each year, covering the prior calendar year activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest and monetary fines (up to 1.5% of assets per month); failure for two consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off of the registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual deadline between April 10 and May 10, determined by the company’s NIT (tax ID) last digit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 0.2% per day on the principal tax due (capped at 100%); repeated non-filing can lead to enforced collection and registration disqualification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed annually under DIAN’s calendar (usually June to August, exact dates per Resolution)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine under Article 651 of the Colombian Tax Code: up to 3.5% of annual gross income or COP 30 million per item in default; risk of account suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio and DIAN (when applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31 (with commercial renewal); for tax purposes, filed with the income tax return in April–May
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty per foreign trade regulation; may block certificates and delay future registrations; criminal liability for misrepresentation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Declaration (Registro de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before July 31, per DIAN Resolution 164/2021 (specific calendar vía RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of up to 2% of the company’s assets (minimum COP 30 million); suspension of tax identification certificate.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit (Revisor Fiscal) if total assets exceed 5,000 monthly minimum legal wages (approx. USD 1.6 million) or gross annual income exceeds 5,000 monthly minimum legal wages; a certified public accountant must otherwise issue a review report for financial statements filed with the Chamber of Commerce.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia under Decree 2420/2015; companies classify as Grupo 2 and apply NIIF para Pymes (IFRS for SMEs) unless listed or considered high-risk (then full IFRS).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: In case of shareholding transfers during the year, the actual beneficial owner list must be updated in the corporate records and reported to DIAN through the annual beneficial owner declaration; no separate UBO filing within 30 days unless the share register itself must be updated at the Chamber of Commerce within 30 days of transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250–600 per year (registered office address service in Bogotá/Medellín, no separate agent fee required for SAS)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200–3,000 per audit cycle for a small-to-mid-size clear-aligner manufacturing entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (general corporate income tax rate under Law 2277 of 2022; no industry-specific surcharge applicable to medical-device / aligner manufacturing)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Approximately 30-32% after utilization of the 100% income-tax deduction for qualifying investments in science, technology and innovation (Article 57.1 E.T. and Decree 640 of 2017); no broad tax holiday for thermoformed-aligner manufacturing; the SIMPLE (small-entity) taxing regime is generally unavailable to a foreign-owned SAS exceeding 3,500 UVT of annual gross income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_rules: Unlimited carryforward for tax losses incurred from fiscal year 2017 onward; annual utilization capped at 12% of pre-NOL net taxable income; no carryback permitted.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 - Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Personas Jurídicas y Asimiladas); mandatory electronic filing through the DIAN MUISCA web portal (https://www.dian.gov.co).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (fiscal year equals calendar year unless expressly authorized); quarterly advance income tax prepayments (anticipos) due in February, May, August and November.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing window is set annually by DIAN Resolution and depends on the last two digits of the tax ID (NIT); for calendar-year taxpayers the statutory deadline generally falls between 12 August and 9 October of the following year (e.g., FY2023 returns were due 12 August 2024 – 9 October 2024). No automatic extension exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Pre-printed form code 210 identifying the annual corporate income tax return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Automatically populated by the DIAN portal; no action required from the non-resident shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Closing net equity (total assets minus total liabilities), including foreign shareholder capital contributions and shareholder loans.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capital subscriptions and loans from the foreign parent must be recorded; a negative net equity triggers dissolution causes under the Colombian Commercial Code.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenues from export sales of thermoformed multilayer aligner sheets (ISIC 3250), domestic sales, and financial income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export revenue is fully taxable in Colombia; no export exemption applies; revenue must be converted at the representative market rate and repatriated through the foreign-exchange market.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct manufacturing costs: multilayer PETG/silicone sheet inputs, thermoforming labor, automated trimming tooling, and production-machine depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Imported inputs must be supported by customs declarations and valid invoices; any purchase from a foreign related party must be documented at arm's length for transfer-pricing purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating deductions: payroll, freight, tariffs, platform fees, software royalties, interest, and R&D investments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to foreign related parties (royalties/interest) are deductible only if withholding tax was settled and supporting TP documentation exists; payments to non-cooperative jurisdictions are non-deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income computed as gross income minus costs, deductions, and tax-law adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-deductible provisions, tax depreciation differences, and fringe-benefit add-backs must be reconciled from IFRS book profit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss carryforward applied against the current-year taxable base (maximum 12% of the post-deduction pre-NOL base per year).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses of the foreign parent or of non-resident shareholders cannot be offset against the SAS taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final corporate income tax assessed at the 35% general rate on the taxable base after NOL compensation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SAS is the sole taxpayer; dividends later remitted to the foreign shareholder are not deductible and trigger the additional dividend withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance income tax payable for the following fiscal year, generally equal to 100% of the income tax assessed in the current year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The anticipo is a Colombian tax asset of the SAS; the foreign shareholder cannot credit it against home-country tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of the Colombian statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal), required when the SAS has assets above 5,000 monthly minimum wages (approx. COP 6.5 billion in 2024) or annual income above 3,000 monthly minimum wages (approx. COP 3.9 billion).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Revisor Fiscal must be a Colombian-certified public accountant; an overseas parent-company audit does not satisfy this requirement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax due per month or fraction, capped at 100% of the tax; if no tax is due, minimum penalty of 10 UVT (approx. COP 470,650 for 2024). Late payment: moratoria interest set by DIAN (typically 25-35% p.a.). Misstatement or omission: penalty of 100-200% of the omitted tax (Articles 648-649 E.T.), plus criminal exposure for willful evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% withholding on dividends remitted to non-resident shareholders when the distributing profits were already subject to the 35% corporate income tax; 35% withholding when dividends are paid from profits that were untaxed or exempt at the corporate level (impuesto adicional de dividendos).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced DTA rate (e.g., 5% with Chile/Mexico; 10-15% with Canada/Spain), the non-resident shareholder must: (i) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from its home tax authority; (ii) execute the DIAN beneficial-ownership declaration (Declaración Juramentada de Beneficiario Efectivo under Decree 2248 of 2017, as amended by Decree 2441 of 2018); and (iii) deliver both documents to the Colombian SAS before the dividend payment. The SAS applies the treaty rate at source and must retain the TRC and declaration for five years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for the use of IP (including aligner design software) paid to a non-resident: 33% statutory withholding tax; DTA rates generally 10-15%. Interest on external debt owed to a foreign financial institution: 15% statutory withholding; DTA rates generally 10%; interest paid to a non-resident non-financial related party: 35% statutory withholding. All cross-border payments must also be canalized through the Colombian foreign-exchange market.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: COP 7,059,750,000 (150,000 UVT of gross income or total net assets for FY2024) triggers the TP informative return and the Local File; COP 21,179,250,000 (450,000 UVT) triggers the Master File; transactions with a single related counterparty equal or exceeding 10,000 UVT (approx. COP 470,650,000) require separate transaction-level TP substantiation.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: TNMM - Método del Margen Neto Transaccional
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply a standalone ESR code, but enforces substance over form through the general anti-avoidance rule (Article 869 E.T.), OECD/BEPS-aligned controlled-foreign-company rules, and permanent-establishment attribution (Article 884 E.T.). A foreign-owned SAS that allegedly manufacturers clear aligner sheets but lacks Colombian premises, production staff, board minutes, or genuine decision-making risks having related-party transactions disregarded and being recharacterized as a conduit of the foreign parent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly understating export revenues from dental clear aligner sheets, inflating deductible costs, omitting foreign bank accounts from Form 210, or failing to file the annual income-tax return altogether.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax correction plus penalty of 100-200% of the omitted tax (Articles 648-649 E.T.); criminal tax evasion under Article 434A of the Colombian Criminal Code (as introduced by Law 1943 of 2018) when the evaded amount exceeds 250 legal minimum monthly wages (approx. COP 325 million in 2024), punishable by 48-108 months of imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative is jointly and severally liable for unpaid corporate taxes when the omission is willful or grossly negligent; criminal judges may impose travel bans (prohibición de salida del país), asset freezes, and, upon conviction, imprisonment for both the administrator and the foreign beneficial owner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating a Colombian SAS without operative substance (no manufacturing plant, no employees, no board meetings) and interposing it in cross-border sales solely to obtain the 5% dividend withholding rate or to shift profits away from the foreign parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard of the abusive transaction under Article 869 E.T., re-determination of the taxable income of the parent or the SAS, penalty of up to 100% of the tax avoided, and an additional fine of 10% of the transaction value; the entity may be declared a façade and dissolved.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Substance-over-form recharacterization pierces the limited-liability shield; directors face civil restitution for recomputed taxes and fines, and may be prosecuted for conspiracy if the shell is used to disguise the origin or destination of funds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the TP informative return, omitting intercompany purchases of multilayer PETG sheet or the transfer of thermoforming equipment from the Local File, or applying a profit margin outside the acceptable interquartile range without a benchmarking study.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Primary TP adjustment increasing taxable income, secondary adjustment recharacterized as a constructive dividend subject to 5%/35% withholding, plus a sanction of 1.5% of the value of the related-party transactions covered by the declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign knowingly false TP documentation are treated as joint and several debtors of the resulting tax assessment; DIAN may petition precautionary seizures (embargos) over their personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving export payments for aligner sheets through Stripe or platform settlement rails without repatriating the foreign currency through the Colombian foreign-exchange market (Decree 1735 of 1993), or accepting funds routed through high-risk jurisdictions without UIAF reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties for unreported FX operations of up to 200% of the amount involved; money-laundering offenses under Law 599 of 2000 (Articles 323-325) carry prison terms of 10-30 years for willful concealment of the origin or destination of funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors must appoint a compliance officer (oficial de cumplimiento) where transaction volumes exceed UIAF thresholds; failure to implement AML procedures exposes directors to criminal liability, travel restrictions, disqualification from corporate office, and personal seizure of assets.
